worldcombat.skill.barrage.summary: Hurl round objects one after another: each ball flies and strikes on its own. Lob mode arcs over cover onto the target but flies slowly and scatters; flat mode is straight and fast with a tight spread, and a round ball ricochets off a wall.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.use.0: Throw round objects one after another from range
worldcombat.skill.barrage.use.1: Lob mode arcs over cover onto the target's head
worldcombat.skill.barrage.use.2: Flat mode is straight and fast, and a round ball ricochets off walls
worldcombat.skill.barrage.description.0: Each ball deals about %1$s physical damage, and the string throws up to %2$s balls (2-5 natively, set by the user's data).
worldcombat.skill.barrage.description.1: Balls come every %1$s and reach %2$s blocks; each flies at %3$s blocks/tick with up to ±%4$s spread (a scattered ball misses).
worldcombat.skill.barrage.description.2: Balls fall at %1$s blocks/tick² with a %2$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.lob.on: Lob: balls arc over cover onto the target, so walls cannot stop them; costs a slow flight (a moving target can step aside), spread x1.5, per-ball power x0.9 and cooldown +2 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.lob.off: Flat: balls are straight and fast with spread x0.7 and per-ball power x1.15; costs being blocked by walls and cover (a blocked ball only ricochets and does no damage).
worldcombat.skill.barrage.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-ball power rises to %2$s and the string grows to %3$s balls.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-ball power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.growth.2: From level %1$s the per-ball power rises to %2$s and the speed to %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.barrage.preference.lob: On (lob): balls arc over cover onto the target, so walls cannot stop them; costs a slow flight (a moving target can step aside), a wider spread, per-ball power x0.9 and cooldown +2 ticks. Off (flat): balls are straight and fast with a tighter spread and per-ball power x1.15; costs being blocked by walls and cover (a blocked ball only ricochets and does no damage).
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. This move has a long range, so the default is large too.
On: targets with no cover between the user and them rank higher because a flat throw is blocked by walls; a target hiding behind a wall ranks lower. Off: all targets score the same.
world_combat.move.barrage.text.out: The target left, so the throws stop (%1$s balls landed)
worldcombat.skill.barrage.description.ou: A ball that hits no enemy only lands (a flat throw bounces once first) and deals no damage; once the target falls or is no longer present, the rest of the string is not thrown.
